1999 SCMR 717
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF PAKISTAN
Before Saeeduzzaman Siddiqui, CJ and Munir A. Sheikh, J
Criminal Appeal No. 45 of 1998
Muhammad Aslam versus The State
Khawaja Muhammad Sharif, Advocate for Appellant
Raja Muhammad Qayyum, Advocate-General for the State
Dates of bearing: 15-01-1999
JUDGMENT
MUNIR A. SHEIKH, J. Through this appeal the appellant has challenged the conviction recorded against him under section 302 PPC. We have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record with their assistance. The ocular account is confidence inspiring and stands corroborated by medical evidence. No misreading or non-reading of evidence has been pointed out. The appeal is dismissed. CR.A-717/L Dismissed
